recent.text: Seth McGowan ranks second among all running backs (minimum 50 touches) in EPA/Rush at 0.1. He’s averaging 5.0 yards per carry on 58 rushes this year. He also ranks top 4 in average kick return yardage (29.2) and overall kick return yardage (847)
recent.author: Zach Hicks

recent.text: #Colts HC Shane Steichen says, again, that QB Daniel Jones did NOT ask to be waived and described Jones' departure as being mutually beneficial for him and the team. Steichen also said Indy is working on signing another QB to pair with Anthony Richardson Sr. and Riley Leonard.
recent.author: James Boyd

recent.text: A bummer of an injury update, as Steichen said that rookie RB Seth McGowan will "miss some time" with his hamstring injury. Just six games left, so hopefully not too much.
recent.author: Jake Arthur

recent.text: Few more Steichen notes: -Seth McGowan (hamstring) will miss some time. -Colts are working through signing a 3rd quarterback. Just Richardson and Leonard on roster, for now. -Steichen says Daniel Jones did not ask to be released.
recent.author: Kevin Bowen
recent.quoted_text: Shane Steichen says #Colts have NOT determined if Alec Pierce will play again in 2026. Is doing some running. Will only put him out there if he's 100 percent.

recent.text: #Colts HC Shane Steichen said they have NOT made a determination about shelving WR Alec Pierce (IR-heel) for the season. Said Pierce is still going through rehab and they'll only put him on the field at 100%.

recent.text: #Colts HC Shane Steichen says the team has NOT ruled out WR Alec Pierce (heel) for the season. However, he adds "the only way we'll put him out there, obviously, if he's 100 (percent). We gotta be really smart with him." Pierce is "doing (plyometrics)" and running, per Steichen.
recent.author: James Boyd

recent.text: Coach Shane Steichen on Alec Pierce: "I know there's reports out there on Alec Pierce being done for the season. We have not made that determination. He's still going through his rehab process. The only way we'll put him out there is if he's 100%. We gotta be really smart."
